references.text: The descendants of Merari received twelve cities, which is confirmed here as the total number of cities assigned to the Merarite clan.
This passage lists the individual cities given to the descendants of Merari, which sum up to twelve cities in verse 40.
Merari is mentioned as one of Levi's three sons, and the Levitical clans were divided according to these three main branches.
1 Chronicles also describes the duties of the Levites and their settlements, including the descendants of Merari.
Parallel account of the cities assigned to the descendants of Merari by casting lots.
God's command to give the Levites cities to live in, which Joshua 21 fulfills.
